newsitem.title: USA: Sun Microsystems buys private software co.
newsitem.headline: Sun Microsystems buys private software co.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc said Tuesday it bought LongView Technologies LLC, a closely held software company, for an undisclosed cash amount.
The seven engineers of LongView, based in Palo Alto, Calif, will join Sun's JavaSoft software unit to help Sun improve its Java computer programming language, the companies said.

In a conference call with analysts, Sun officials declined to disclose details about LongView's technology and how Sun will use it in its products. Sun also declined to say how much it paid for LongView, but said it paid cash.
The companies will reveal more details about their plans at the JavaOne trade show in April. (( -- Kourosh Karimkhany, in Palo Alto, +1 415 846 5401 ))
